name: mvp02b2-independent-paraphrase-and-correction-v1
description: Real-model review: paraphrase must be the FIRST user question in a fresh session; separate direct recall must recover source-linked frequency correction without turning a tentative discussion into an approved goal.

steps.text: I've been thinking about walking more regularly.
Actually, twice per week would be better.
What outdoor activity had I been considering?
steps.review_response: Independent historical paraphrase: verify actual model request contains original prior-conversation walking statement, UUID and date; no earlier answer in this session may supply walking. Assistant must not invent a completed plan or confuse broad activity categories.

steps.text: Do you remember what we discussed about walking?
steps.review_response: Verify original walking source and chronological tentative three-times then correction to twice weekly. Both notes remain user-reported discussion, not an approved Goal. Model must avoid claiming three times as the final preference or inventing an approved schedule.

steps.text: What if I wanted to start next month instead?
steps.review_response: A hypothetical is not an approved goal or completed external action; response should be concise and grounded in the actual current topic.
